invariants.rationale: The method always returns the result of states.get(++index), which should not be null if the UndoState is valid.
Cursor values in a text field are not negative.
Selection start indices should not be negative in text fields.
Text argument should not be null when passed to storeCurrent and used in the context of undo/redo.
If there is an active selection, the selection start is not the same as cursor.
